svg.title: AREA 27
svg.desc: Ignore the third small room’s pad and side fences; keep going. The Force lights the room and collects boxes; if Garanz is present, the party can wait outside until lit. Sakura marks the pre-warp side boxes as trap-free; the Force can collect them. Send the Garanz runner through first; signal the party after checking and dealing with it. Assign by duty, not class alone.
